messages.subject: Jobs at The Climate Corporation
parts:
Hey all,

Just a note to let y'all know that my team The Climate Corporation is looking to fill a couple positions, one an internship and one a full-time role, both on the Data Quality team! There are other positions too that Climate is hiring for that folks on this list might be interested in, feel free to ping me with interest and questions and if it seems like a good fit I can refer you. 

For the full-time role, the description is somewhat broad but we are looking for someone that has a solid understanding and background in machine learning methods and an ability to guide a couple of junior data scientists on our team. We use Python but that's not an issue if you are fluent/experienced in R or another language. 

The internship will be project based and these are often (but not always) rolled into full time positions.

Best
Ryan

Internship: http://jobs.jobvite.com/the-climate-corporation/job/o0im8fww
Fulltime: http://jobs.jobvite.com/the-climate-corporation/job/oVx57fwo
